title: Preface to International Public Sector Accounting Standards
nativeTitle: Preface to International Public Sector Accounting Standards
summary: Sets out the objectives, scope, publication suite, authority, equal authority of bold/plain type paragraphs, dual accrual/cash development tracks, and voluntary adoption framework of the IPSASB.
description: The Preface to International Public Sector Accounting Standards explains the institutional origin and public interest objective of the IPSASB. It defines the scope of entities to which IPSAS apply (non-profit public sector service providers), establishes the equal authority of bold and plain text paragraphs, outlines the two accrual development tracks (converged with IFRS vs public-sector-specific), explains the transitional path from cash to accrual accounting, and notes the voluntary nature of adoption across jurisdictions.
